verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Blueprints allow instant in-editor scripting changes without recompilation, and C++ changes are 'reflected in the Unreal Editor after compiling' via Visual Studio/XCode, indicating a hot-reload/live-coding workflow exists. However, no evidence quantifies compile/reload speed, mentions the dedicated 'Live Coding' feature explicitly, or provides independent hands-on confirmation that the loop is fast rather than just functional. Missing for 10: benchmark/timing evidence on hot reload speed, explicit mention of Live Coding feature, independent developer testimony on edit-run loop responsiveness.
